title: CLO 2025.1 - UI
description: CLO 2025.1 new version fully upgraded to further enhance your work efficiency! In the new version, we have optimized and updated the library, virtual model information display, and 2D snapshot features. Follow the video to see the specific upgrade details.
transcript:
Now I will introduce the update of the UI-related functions.  
In the new version 2025.1,  
we have optimized and updated the library.  
We have added the label page of Connect Shop,  
making it more convenient to purchase and download assets there,  
and we have synchronized the selection function of the web page,  
allowing you to find the content you need more quickly.  

Go to the library and click Connect Shop.  
First, let's find a free fabric asset and double-click it.  
You can see that the fabric is directly added to the object window.  
Let's try dragging a free clothing asset directly.  
You can see that there is also an additional asset search and selection function here.  
We can choose clothing first and open the selector.  
You can see that there are gender, age, style, and other corresponding options here.  
Then we can select one of the five asset options.  
We can make a selection according to the assets we want.  
You can also search by inputting keywords.  
You can see this clothing is directly added.  
The selection options corresponding to different asset types are also different.  

Now let's try to buy a paid clothing asset. At this time, we need to right-click on the asset,  
we can see that the purchase cart will appear and open in Connect. Click on the purchase cart and open it,  
you can see that you can check the assets that have been added to the purchase cart; click on purchase and it will automatically jump to the purchase interface.  
After the purchase is completed, the assets can be added to our project. We can also check the purchase record at the bottom;  
your purchased assets will be recorded here and categorized.  
We can see that the 2025.1 design optimization makes it easier for us to add assets from Connect to the business city,  
to find and use resources more quickly.  

In the new 2025.1 version, the virtual model information display function has been added to the semi-transparent surface,  
allowing users to check the relationship between the model and the version while editing the version.  
At the same time, the display grid of the virtual model can be added separately at the bottom,  
making it more convenient to use. When we are making clothing, we hope to be able to see the relationship between the clothing and the virtual model from all directions.  
For example, when the virtual model is the physical surface or the black and white surface, we cannot directly check the relationship between the garment and the virtual model;  
some parts of the garment version will be blocked by the model. We go to the 3D vertical menu, find the virtual model information display, and choose semi-transparent surface.  
At this time, we can see that the virtual model is semi-transparent. You can check the clothing and the garment,  
and objectively see whether the sleeves are in harmony with the virtual model.  
In the virtual model information display, open the display grid. When we use the display grid,  
while switching the model information display, it can also maintain the grid display state,  
and then we can see that the virtual model is in harmony with the model.  

The cloud 2025.1 gives users the advantage of virtual model display,  
so users can check the clothing and virtual model information more objectively,  
and have a more comfortable experience during the creation process.  

In the previous version,  
when you import or export a 3D file, you can select the desired option below and save it in the Preview File Manager, and you can also name the preview.  
Next time you import or export a file, you only need to select the preset option you saved.  

Click on the 3D file, select import, and use the FBX file as an example.  
Find the FBX file, click open.  
Change the settings below.  
Click Add, you will see a preset path here.  
You can set it yourself.  
After setting the preset path,  
you can name the preset, for example, import preset1.  
Click OK.  
Now we can delete this FBX file.  

Let's try to import FBX again.  
When you change the following settings, you will find that the preset has become the selected configuration.  
At this point, click Add in the preset.  
Create a new preset name, for example, import preset2.  
Now you can see that there are two preset options that you have previously set up.  
Click to confirm the import.  

Next time when you need to export FBX files with the same settings, you can select the settings you have previously created.  
Then the export file is also the same, click to import the file.  
Select the save location and change the export settings below.  
Click to add preset path and name.  
Next time when you export FBX files, you can select the same settings as before.  

In the new version of Kolo, the new configuration is used to import and export files.  
It can save time and provide a direct path for users.  

In the new version, the 2D quick photo function has also been updated.  
In the 2D quick photo, a new 2D line option has been added.  
You can change the color and type of the line here.  
Find the file and open the 2D version of the quick photo, the 1-to-1.  
By pressing the left button, 2D 1-to-1, the 2D quick photo play window appears.  
You can see the screen compared to the previous version.  
This version can more directly view the line option and other information options.  
You can change the lines in the line option to point curves and hollow lines,  
and you can also change the color of the line.  
Here we can see that the base line and the cutout are displayed separately.  

When you have set up the option of 2D quick photo, you can choose to save it.  
At the same time, the quick photo function in the cherry blossom release mode has also been updated.  
The 2D quick photo optimization update allows users to more freely edit the output effect of the 2D version and have more self-determined choices.  

When users adjust the clothing version in the building, it is necessary to ensure that the unit is the same size as the actual clothing.  
In the new version 2025.1, you can adjust the number of decimal places in the system.  
Select a line to view.  
Currently, only one decimal place can be seen.  
Open the settings.  
Navigate to user self-definition.  
User interface.  
Find the unit decimal places.  
The decimal places can be set from 1 to 5 by yourself, allowing us to change the number of decimal places to 4.  
Click to adjust.  

Jump to the user profile.  
Go to the driver уinc.com box.  
The information we are going to stand up here indicates that there’s no issue with the cameo issues in the original photos.

chunks.title: CLO 2025.1 - UI
chunks.content: ## UI Updates in CLO 2025.1 This section details the new UI-related features and optimizations introduced in CLO version 2025.1, including improvements to the Connect Shop library, asset selection, and integration workflows. ### Connect Shop Library Enhancements CLO 2025.1 optimizes the Connect Shop library by adding a dedicated label page, streamlining asset purchase and download processes. The asset selection function is synchronized with the web page, enabling faster content discovery. - **Accessing Connect Shop**: Navigate to the library and click **Connect Shop**. - **Free Asset Usage**: Double-click a free fabric asset to add it directly to the object window. - **Drag and Drop**: Drag free clothing assets directly into the workspace. - **Asset Search and Selection**: Includes filters such as gender, age, and style, allowing selection among multiple asset options. - **Keyword Search**: Users can input keywords to locate specific assets. - **Asset Type Specific Filters**: Different asset types offer tailored selection options. ### Purchasing Paid Assets - **Purchase Process**: Right-click on a paid clothing asset to add it to the purchase cart within Connect Shop. - **Purchase Cart Interface**: Review assets in the cart, click **Purchase**, and the system redirects to the purchase interface. - **Post-Purchase Integration**: Purchased assets can be added directly to the project. - **Purchase History**: A categorized record of purchased assets is maintained at the bottom interface. These updates improve the efficiency of adding assets from Connect Shop to the CLO workspace. --- ## Virtual Model Information Display This section explains the new virtual model display features in CLO 2025.1, aimed at improving the visualization of clothing fitting and version editing. ### Semi-Transparent Surface Mode - **Purpose**: Allows users to view the relationship between the garment and virtual model while editing. - **Usage**: Found in the 3D vertical menu under "Virtual Model Information Display," select **Semi-Transparent Surface**. - **Benefit**: The virtual model becomes semi-transparent, enabling clear observation of garment fit, such as sleeve harmony. ### Display Grid Feature - **Functionality**: Adds a grid overlay at the bottom of the virtual model display, aiding spatial orientation. - **Persistence**: The grid remains visible even when switching model display modes. - **Use Case**: Facilitates multi-directional inspection of the garment's fit relative to the model. The integration of these visualization tools enhances objectivity and comfort during clothing design. --- ## Import and Export Preset Management for 3D Files This section covers new preset configuration features for importing and exporting 3D files, particularly FBX, in CLO 2025.1. ### Creating Import Presets - Select 3D file import (e.g., FBX). - Adjust import settings as needed. - Click **Add** to save the current settings as a preset. - Name the preset (e.g., **import preset1**). - Confirm with **OK**. ### Using Presets - On subsequent imports, select previously saved presets to apply consistent settings quickly. - Multiple presets can be created and managed. ### Export Presets - When exporting FBX files, adjust export settings. - Save these as presets by clicking **Add**, naming the preset accordingly.

Multiple presets can be created and managed. ### Export Presets - When exporting FBX files, adjust export settings. - Save these as presets by clicking **Add**, naming the preset accordingly. - Use saved presets for consistent export configurations. ### Benefits - Saves time by eliminating repetitive configuration. - Provides a direct path and naming management for preview files. - Improves workflow consistency when handling 3D assets. --- ## 2D Quick Photo Function Update This section describes enhancements to the 2D Quick Photo feature, focusing on line options and output customization. ### New 2D Line Option - Allows users to modify line color and type within the 2D Quick Photo interface. - Supported line types include point curves and hollow lines. - Base line and cutout lines are displayed separately for clarity. ### Accessing 2D Quick Photo - Open the 2D version of the quick photo (1:1 scale). - Launch the 2D quick photo play window via the left mouse button. ### Customization and Saving - Users can freely edit output effects and save their line and color configurations. - The updated function supports more self-determined choices for output aesthetics. ### Application - Enhances visual clarity for pattern and garment design steps. - Supports the Cherry Blossom release mode optimization for quick photo editing. --- ## Unit Precision Adjustment in Clothing Versioning This section explains the new feature allowing users to customize decimal precision for measurements in CLO 2025.1. ### Adjusting Decimal Places - Navigate to **Settings > User Self-Definition > User Interface**. - Locate **Unit Decimal Places**. - Decimal places can be adjusted from 1 to 5. - Example: Changing from 1 decimal place to 4 decimal places improves measurement accuracy. ### Importance - Ensures that the internal unit measurements correspond closely to actual clothing sizes. - Critical for detailed garment version adjustments and precise fitting. --- ## Additional Notes - The update mentions a driver-related message referencing "driver уinc.com box," indicating no issues with cameo in original photos, implying system stability for image processing. - CLO 2025.1 overall focuses on usability improvements, workflow efficiency, and enhanced visualization tools for virtual garment design and asset management.
